scope: Manually selected, source-attributed excerpts from public research. This is not full-report evaluation or native SIEM testing.

cases.excerpt: RMM.Agent.exe service launched PowerShell. The PowerShell process modified the execution policy for the current session and executed Invoke-WebRequest commands
cases.review_note: Report describes RMM-to-PowerShell activity; this excerpt omits wider source context. Evaluate extraction only, not maliciousness or local relevance.

cases.excerpt: launches the Microsoft-signed “GatherOsState.exe”, which sideloads “slc.dll”, the Antino backdoor.
cases.review_note: A signed-host DLL load is an observation in published research, but filename-only detection needs paths/signatures and benign testing.

cases.excerpt: The PowerShell downloader contacts geo-fenced servers located in Russia and Germany to download the second stage Zip file containing the Remcos backdoor.
cases.review_note: Geographical description alone does not identify a destination hostname or other bounded network predicate.

cases.excerpt: Two days later on March 6, the attacker ran more PowerShell scripts to download and execute a Sliver payload labeled "vmware_kb.exe".
cases.review_note: A payload filename without the initiating process, actual command and telemetry relationship is insufficient for this bounded behavior extractor.
